source.title: Forebears Tanzania forenames and surnames frequency tables

names.notes: Public frequency tables were used to seed localized Tanzanian given names and surnames. Gender buckets remain sample-level because they are not sourced from an official civil registry.

source.title: ITU Operational Bulletin 898: Tanzania E.164 national numbering plan

phones.notes: ITU/TCRA confirms country code +255, fixed nine-digit national significant numbers, and the listed mobile NDCs. The public TCRA site points to newer numbering-plan publications, but the directly parsed authority source used here is older; generated numbers are synthetic and are not checked for live assignment or portability.

locations.notes: UPU confirms Tanzania uses five-digit postcodes to the left of the locality and provides Dar es Salaam, Arusha and Mwanza examples. Prefixes preserve those public example stems but generated trailing digits are synthetic and not address-validated.

national_identification_number.label: National Identification Number

source.title: Tanzania NIDA online NIN request example

national_identification_number.notes: The official NIDA online service gives one example NIN in the grouped 8-5-5-2 digit display shape. Generated values follow only that sample display shape, use random digits, and are not registry-checked.
